text: The rocbuild generator reverses sorted local dependency names because it inserts each entry at index zero. This leaves the final local group in ascending order ahead of general dependencies, while the Mozilla hack entries get their explicit leading positions. Current rust.py preserves that logic. Sort direction must be read together with the insertion operation. Change the generator rather than sorting the generated Cargo.toml by hand; the broader generated-output rule is already shared.
title: Account for front insertion when sorting generated dependency tables
